description: Django views module for the 'cookbook' application, handling web requests such as index, space management, system info, and static assets.

classes.name: Redoc
classes.description: API documentation view with guest group permission requirement.

classes.name: Swagger
classes.description: Swagger API schema view with guest group permission requirement.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main page handler, shows setup or frontend based on user state.

methods.name: redirect_recipe_view
methods.description: Redirects to a specific recipe view, optionally sharing.

methods.name: redirect_recipe_share_view
methods.description: Redirects to a recipe share link if valid.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Handles search page redirection based on permissions.

methods.name: no_groups
methods.description: Displays info when user has no groups.

methods.name: space_overview
methods.description: Handles creation and joining of spaces.

methods.name: switch_space
methods.description: Switches user active space.

methods.name: no_perm
methods.description: Displays no permission message.

methods.name: recipe_pdf_viewer
methods.description: Displays PDF view of a recipe if access is valid.

methods.name: system
methods.description: Displays system info, including database, migrations, and API stats.

methods.name: plugin_update
methods.description: Updates plugin via git pull if user is superuser.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup page for creating first superuser.

methods.name: invite_link
methods.description: Handles invite link validation and user space creation.

methods.name: report_share_abuse
methods.description: Reports abusive share links.

methods.name: web_manifest
methods.description: Provides web app manifest JSON.

methods.name: markdown_info
methods.description: Renders markdown info page.

methods.name: search_info
methods.description: Renders search info page.

methods.name: offline
methods.description: Offline page.

methods.name: service_worker
methods.description: Serves service worker JS file.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Test page for ingredient parser, only in DEBUG mode.

methods.name: test2
methods.description: Another test page, only in DEBUG mode.

methods.name: tandoor_frontend
methods.description: Renders Tandoor frontend page.

methods.name: get_orphan_files
methods.description: Finds and optionally deletes orphan media files.
